Class QuoteService

public inherited sharing class QuoteService

Service class for Quote-related operations such as PDF document generation. Reads PDF template configuration from CodeSettings__mdt and creates QuoteDocument records via Salesforce's PageReference.getContentAsPDF().

Methods

public static QuoteService.PdfResult generatePdf(Id quoteId)

Generates a PDF document for the specified Quote and saves it as a QuoteDocument. Reads the QUOTE_PDF_TEMPLATE_ID setting from CodeSettings__mdt to build the template URL with header/footer heights. In test context, uses a fake blob to avoid the PageReference.getContentAsPDF() callout.

Parameters:
    quoteId – The Id of the Quote to generate a PDF for

Returns:
    PdfResult: Contains the success flag, error message, and created QuoteDocument Id
